## Glossary

**4.5:1**  
Minimum contrast every accent holds on the background and card, enforced by a test.

**agentic**  
Domain palette: green primary, blue tertiary for shared, pink quaternary for Signet.

**--app-* slots**  
The four palette slots (primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary) each domain fills; marketing CSS reads them directly.

**--app-primary**  
The page's one accent (CTA, eyebrow, wordmark stop); follows a nested data-domain.

**building-blocks**  
Domain palette: amber primary, teal tertiary, brick quaternary.

**button / button-secondary / text-link**  
Marketing call-to-action classes.

**.dark**  
Class on <html> that switches to the dark theme; light is :root.

**data-domain**  
Attribute selecting a palette: agentic, building-blocks, governance or inixiative.

**eyebrow + status-dot**  
Marketing classes for the small label above a heading.

**governance**  
Domain palette: violet primary, jade tertiary, rose quaternary.

**HSL channels**  
Token values are bare channels, used as hsl(var(--token)) or hsl(var(--token) / alpha).

**inixiative**  
Neutral ink palette whose other slots are the three domains' primaries, for the hub.

**@layer components**  
Layer holding the .marketing classes so Tailwind utilities and unlayered CSS override them.

**load order**  
Apps: public, status, own CSS. Marketing: public, domains, marketing, after template's theme.css.

**.marketing**  
Class on the page root that scopes the shared marketing classes.

**nav, brand, section, card, card-grid, footer, prose**  
The other shared marketing layout classes; .prose is set for the light theme.

**prefers-reduced-motion**  
When it is set, marketing.css zeroes the motion tokens.

**--status-***  
problem / attention / working / queued / done / idle / archived tokens in status.css.

**--success / --warning / --error**  
Status colour tokens in public.css.

**theme**  
The class of brand CSS files under @inixiative/config/theme/ and the rules for loading them.

**theme/domains.css**  
Four palettes on one slot structure, selected with data-domain on any element; they nest.

**theme/fonts/***  
The latin variable fonts public.css loads from ./fonts/: Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans, JetBrains Mono.

**theme/marketing.css**  
The marketing grammar: fluid type, spacing, section rhythm, radius, elevation, motion tokens and the .marketing classes.

**theme/public.css**  
The brand base: --app-* slots, status, UI and type tokens, and the @font-face rules.

**theme/status.css**  
Thread/work status tokens (--status-problem … --status-archived) and the badge layer for apps showing agent work.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The brand theme shipped as CSS from @inixiative/config: the base tokens and fonts, the agent-work status layer, the four nestable domain palettes and the marketing grammar, plus the rules for loading and reading them.

## 2. The domain

theme/public.css always loads first: base, --app-* slots, status (--success / --warning / --error), UI and type tokens, and @font-face for Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono, which load from ./fonts/ next to it (theme/fonts/*, served as it ships). Apps then load theme/status.css (the --status-* thread/work tokens and badges, for apps that show agent work) and then their own CSS. Marketing pages load public.css, theme/domains.css, then theme/marketing.css (after template's theme.css where an app has one), and put class="marketing" data-domain="…" on the page root.

Four rules decide whether colours come out right. Load order matters because [data-domain] ties :root/.dark on specificity. Values are HSL channels, so read them as hsl(var(--app-primary)) or hsl(var(--border) / .5); marketing CSS reads the --app-* slots, because template's --primary is resolved once on :root and does not follow a nested data-domain. Light is :root and dark is the .dark class on <html>. A test holds every accent at 4.5:1 or more on the background and the card, so a new or changed palette has to pass it. The .marketing classes sit in @layer components, so Tailwind utilities and unlayered page CSS override them.

Not here: depending on or bumping @inixiative/config belongs to version-coherence; tsconfig, Biome and tsup config belong to toolchain-presets; retired product names in page copy belong to retired-terms; the local port a page's dev server uses belongs to port-registry.

### Class `theme`: Style with the brand theme CSS: theme/{public,status,domains,marketing}.css tokens, status badges, data-domain palettes, .marketing classes, fonts, load order and contrast

**Job: pick which theme CSS file to load for a page** (public.css vs status.css vs domains.css vs marketing.css) — README.md § Presets

*Said as:* "add the brand styles to the app", "style the marketing landing page", "show coloured status badges for agent work", "give this section the governance colours"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **theme/public.css** | always, first: base, --app-* slots, status, UI and type tokens, fonts | you need work-status badges too (add theme/status.css) |
| **theme/status.css** | apps that show agent work: --status-* tokens and badges | marketing pages (use theme/domains.css and theme/marketing.css) |
| **theme/domains.css** | per-domain accents via data-domain, nestable | only the base brand is needed (theme/public.css) |
| **theme/marketing.css and .marketing classes** | marketing pages: type scale, sections, buttons, cards, prose | app UI (use theme/public.css then theme/status.css) |
| **theme/fonts/** | serving the font folder as shipped beside public.css | never import directly; theme/public.css loads them |

**Job: wire the theme CSS so colours and dark mode come out right** (Theme wiring rules) — README.md § Presets; § Presets › Domain palettes

*Said as:* "the domain colour doesn't apply in this section", "dark mode isn't switching", "accent colour is hard to read on the background", "what order do the theme files go in"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **Theme CSS load order** | deciding import order; data-domain ties :root/.dark on specificity | a value is used without hsl() (use Theme colour access via HSL channels) |
| **Theme colour access via HSL channels** | reading tokens: hsl(var(--app-primary)), not --primary under data-domain | the page root lacks its classes (use Marketing page root and dark mode) |
| **Marketing page root and dark mode** | class marketing plus data-domain on the root; .dark on html | choosing palette colours (use Accent contrast minimum) |
| **Accent contrast minimum** | adding or changing a palette: 4.5:1 on background and card | using the shipped palettes as they are |

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#presets -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Presets (in "@inixiative/config")

#### Presets

| Export | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `@inixiative/config/tsconfig/base.json` | the shared compiler options (ESNext, bundler resolution, `strict`, `noEmit`, `verbatimModuleSyntax`, `types: ["bun"]`); `check` holds a repo's `tsconfig.json` to extending a `tsconfig/` preset |
| `@inixiative/config/tsconfig/node.json`, `tsconfig/react.json` | base plus `types: ["node"]` (picked only with `--preset=node`), or base plus the DOM libs and `jsx: react-jsx` (picked when the repo depends on `react`) |
| `@inixiative/config/biome/base.json`, `biome/react.json` | the Biome formatter (2 spaces, width 100, single quotes, trailing commas, semicolons) and lint rules; react adds `useExhaustiveDependencies` as a warning. `check` holds `biome.json` to extending base (and react for a react repo) |
| `@inixiative/config/lefthook/base.yml` | the shared pre-commit hooks (typecheck, Biome on staged TS files) that a repo's `lefthook.yml` extends |
| `@inixiative/config/tsup` | `node(options)` and `react(options)` tsup presets (`src/index.ts` to CJS + ESM with dts and sourcemaps; react externalises `react`, `react-dom` and `react/jsx-runtime`); options override the base, and `dts: true` keeps the TS 6.0 fix below |
| `@inixiative/config/versions.json`, `ports.json` | the BOM and the local port registry, both below |
| `@inixiative/config/theme/public.css` | the brand: base, `--app-*` slots, status (`--success` / `--warning` / `--error`), UI (incl. `--shadow`) and type tokens, plus `@font-face` for Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono |
| `@inixiative/config/theme/status.css` | the thread/work status layer (`--status-problem / attention / working / queued / done / idle / archived`) and the badge layer, for apps that show agent work |
| `@inixiative/config/theme/domains.css` | four palettes on one structure, set with `data-domain="agentic \| building-blocks \| governance \| inixiative"` on any element; they nest |
| `@inixiative/config/theme/marketing.css` | the marketing grammar: fluid type scale, spacing and section rhythm, container and gutter, radius, elevation and motion tokens (zeroed under `prefers-reduced-motion`), and the shared classes inside `.marketing` (`eyebrow` + `status-dot`, `button` / `button-secondary` / `text-link`, `nav`, `brand`, `section`, `card`, `card-grid`, `footer`, `prose`, all in `@layer components` so Tailwind utilities and unlayered page CSS override them) |
| `@inixiative/config/theme/fonts/*` | the latin variable fonts `public.css` loads (SIL OFL 1.1, texts in `theme/fonts/LICENSES.md`) |

Apps load `public.css`, then `status.css`, then their own CSS. Marketing pages load `public.css`, `domains.css`, then `marketing.css` (after template's `theme.css` where an app has it: `[data-domain]` ties `:root`/`.dark` on specificity, so load order decides), and put `class="marketing" data-domain="…"` on the page root. Light is `:root`; dark is the `.dark` class on `<html>`. Values are HSL channels: `hsl(var(--app-primary))`, `hsl(var(--border) / .5)`. The fonts load from `./fonts/` relative to `public.css`, so serve the folder as it ships. `demo/marketing.html` (not shipped) shows every domain, the type scale, buttons, sections and long-form prose; open it from a checkout.

##### Domain palettes

Each palette fills the same four slots; marketing CSS reads the slots directly (`--app-primary`), because template's `--primary` is resolved once on `:root` and does not follow a nested `data-domain`. The primary is the page's one accent (CTA, eyebrow, wordmark stop). Tertiary and quaternary appear only where they mean something (agentic: blue = shared, pink = Signet). `inixiative` is neutral ink; its secondary, tertiary and quaternary are the agentic, building-blocks and governance primaries, so each door on the hub can wear its domain. Long-form reading (`.prose`) is set for the light theme.

Contrast as text on the background (light `#f6f7f2`, dark ink `#0b1014`); the test holds every accent at 4.5:1 or more on the background and the card, and each accent's foreground on the accent.

| Domain | Slot | Light | on `#f6f7f2` | Dark | on ink |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agentic | primary | `#466713` | 6.08 | `#c8f77e` | 15.53 |
| agentic | tertiary (shared) | `#1e69b8` | 5.18 | `#94c8ff` | 10.89 |
| agentic | quaternary (Signet) | `#a33e84` | 5.45 | `#f1b7e2` | 11.48 |
| building-blocks | primary (amber) | `#955104` | 5.64 | `#faba4c` | 11.10 |
| building-blocks | tertiary (teal) | `#0c6d6e` | 5.69 | `#51d6cd` | 10.79 |
| building-blocks | quaternary (brick) | `#ae3f29` | 5.51 | `#f9a18b` | 9.56 |
| governance | primary (violet) | `#613bba` | 6.86 | `#c0a7fb` | 9.25 |
| governance | tertiary (jade) | `#12684e` | 6.26 | `#66d6ad` | 10.73 |
| governance | quaternary (rose) | `#a92d42` | 6.21 | `#fba7b8` | 10.31 |
| inixiative | primary (ink) | `#0d1317` | 17.37 | `#eff2ed` | 16.93 |

Apps load the theme from this package at runtime, so it is a runtime `dependency` of theirs. To keep that cheap this package has no runtime dependencies and every peer is optional; a test holds both.
